label: preparing
what: A coordinated community supper and service acknowledgement in the great hall at eighteen, apparently kept partly secret from the mayor under the lighting-inspection appointment. Builder manages the hall and requests it stay closed; innkeeper coordinates hospitality and brings bread. Neighbour solicits bread or grain and escorts the mayor, secretary schedules and accompanies the mayor, and baker and freight assist with hall access/logistics. The precise acknowledgement and its intended recipient remain unconfirmed.
